```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
library(rjp)
library(magrittr)
```

```{r, results = 'asis', echo = FALSE}
calendar_css() %>% cat()
Cal <-
  calendar("daily.txt", mask = c(2, 4, 6),
         start = lubridate::mdy("1/28/2019")) 
Cal %>% 
  html_calendar(show = 2:6, items = c("Topic", "Read", "R", "Due", "Note")) %>%
  cat()
```


```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 10, eval = FALSE, include = FALSE}
calendar("daily.txt", mask = c(2,3,5,6),
         start = lubridate::mdy("1/28/2019")) %>%
  gg_calendar(show = 2:6) 
```
